description: Markdown a coding agent reads before every session (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`): commands, conventions and rules for the folder it lives in.
In a monorepo the root file and every file on the path to the edited code apply; the deepest one is read last and takes precedence.
A folder with a `SKILL.md` (name, description, instructions) and optional scripts and references, loaded only when a task needs it.
Metadata of every skill always in context, the body only when selected, bundled files only when the body points to them.
The list of skill names and descriptions in the system context, so the model knows what it can ask for.
The tokens you allow for instructions. Always-on context must fit; skills compete for the rest.
